welcome:
👋 Hi! I'm a notification bot for GitLab/GitHub.
Use /connect URL to connect a repository.
/help — list of commands.
help:
📚 Available commands:
/start — get started
/connect URL — connect a repository
/status — connected repositories status
/help — this help
connect_dev:
🔗 Repository connection feature is in development.
GitHub/GitLab integration coming soon!
unknown_command: Sorry, I only understand commands. Type /help
send_failed: ❌ Failed to send message to chat %d: %v
star_created: ⭐ %s — new star! 👤 %s %s 🔗 View repo | Stargazers
star_deleted: 💔 %s — star removed 👤 %s %s 🔗 View repo | Stargazers
configure_chat_is_not_forum: ❌ This chat is not a forum. Enable "Topics" in group settings first.
configure_chat_not_admin: ❌ I need to be an administrator to create topics. Grant me admin rights first.
configure_chat_success:
✅ Forum topics created successfully!

You can now configure which events go to which topic.
configure_chat_how_to_use: 💡 How to use: 1. Create webhook: /connect 2. Notifications will appear in the General topic by default 3. Future update: map events to specific topics
failed_save_topic_to_storage: ❌ Failed to save topic '%s' to storage: %v
failed_to_map_event_to_storage: ❌ Failed to map event '%s' to topic %d: %v
failed_to_check_bot_admin_status: ❌ Failed to check bot admin status: %v
connect_invalid_url: ❌ Invalid URL. Must be a GitHub or GitLab repository URL.
connect_github: 💡 GitHub setup: 1. Go to Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook 2. Paste the URL above 3. Select events: Send me everything
connect_gitlab: 💡 GitLab setup: 1. Go to Settings → Webhooks 2. Paste the URL above 3. Select triggers: Push, Merge Request, Issues, etc.
connect_failed: ❌ Failed to save repository configuration. Please try again.
connect_logged: New repository connected: chat=%d repo=%s webhook=%s
connect_no_domain:
❌ DOMAIN is not set in .env file. Set it to your server's public IP or domain.

Example: DOMAIN=IP/DOMAIN:PORT
no_chats_configured: No chats configured, sending to default chat
